column1: Terlalu besar untuk HP ini, game dan HP bisa jadi lambat.
column2: Too large for this phone; the game and the phone may become slow.

column1: Batas memori Java (-Xmx). Lebih besar tidak selalu lebih cepat.
column2: Java memory limit (-Xmx). Bigger is not always faster.

column1: Opsional, untuk pengguna mahir. Salah isi bisa membuat game gagal jalan.
column2: Optional, for advanced users. Wrong values can stop the game from running.

column1: Mematikan awan dan bayangan secara otomatis supaya FPS lebih tinggi.
column2: Automatically turns off clouds and shadows for higher FPS.

column1: Lebih kecil = FPS lebih tinggi, gambar lebih buram.
Pilih implementasi driver Vulkan yang dipakai sistem/game.
column2: Choose the Vulkan driver implementation used by the system/game.

column1: Atur API grafis yang dipakai Minecraft modern 26.2+.
column2: Sets the graphics API used by modern Minecraft 26.2+.

column1: Paksa pakai driver Vulkan bawaan HP (bukan Turnip). Memengaruhi renderer Zink.
column2: Force the phone's built-in Vulkan driver (not Turnip). Affects the Zink renderer.

column1: Sinkronisasi vertikal untuk renderer Kopper Zink lewat antarmuka sistem.
column2: Vertical sync for the Kopper Zink renderer through the system interface.

column1: Bahasa teks di launcher. Ikuti sistem memakai bahasa HP.
column2: Language of the launcher text. Follow system uses your phone's language.

column1: Foto paling ringan, GIF bergerak dengan ringan, video paling halus (HD, bisa 60 fps) tapi memakai baterai lebih banyak.
column2: Photos are the lightest, GIFs move with little load, videos are the smoothest (HD, up to 60 fps) but use more battery.

column1: Matikan untuk menampilkan gambar diam saja. Paling hemat baterai dan RAM.
column2: Turn off to show a still image only. Saves the most battery and RAM.

column1: GIF dan video berhenti otomatis selama mode Hemat Baterai HP menyala.
column2: GIFs and videos pause automatically while the phone's Battery Saver mode is on.

column1: Bawaan mati. Otomatis bisu bila aplikasi lain sedang memutar musik.
column2: Off by default. Automatically muted when another app is playing audio.

column1: Cahaya lembut di sidebar dan tepi kartu Beranda. Warnanya mengikuti isi GIF atau video. Tidak berlaku untuk foto.
column2: A soft glow on the sidebar and the edges of the Home cards. Its color follows the GIF or video. Does not apply to photos.

column1: Ubah tata letak tombol, ukuran, transparansi, scroll hotbar, dan pemetaan tombol Minecraft.
column2: Change button layout, size, transparency, hotbar scrolling, and Minecraft key mapping.

column1: Sentuh tombol atau slot menu langsung di mana jari menekan.
column2: Touch buttons or menu slots directly where your finger presses.

column1: Geser jari untuk menggerakkan kursor virtual, ketuk layar untuk klik.
column2: Slide your finger to move the virtual cursor, tap the screen to click.

column1: Ketuk atau tahan di area kosong layar untuk memukul. Matikan supaya menggeser kamera tidak ikut memukul; pakai tombol pukul.
column2: Tap or hold an empty area of the screen to attack. Turn off so dragging the camera does not attack too; use the attack button instead.

column1: Kecepatan memutar pandangan di dalam game.
column2: How fast the view turns in the game.

column1: Kecepatan kursor saat berada di menu Minecraft.
column2: Cursor speed while in Minecraft menus.

column1: Sembunyikan kursor virtual otomatis jika mouse eksternal tersambung.
column2: Automatically hide the virtual cursor when an external mouse is connected.

column1: Sesuaikan backend grafis dengan Minecraft & GPU perangkat
column2: Match the graphics backend to your Minecraft version and your device's GPU

column1: Launcher mendeteksi perangkatmu menggunakan GPU Adreno. Mengaktifkan opsi ini dapat menyebabkan perender Zink tidak berfungsi atau crash. Apakah Anda yakin ingin mengaktifkannya?
column2: The launcher detected that your device uses an Adreno GPU. Enabling this option can make the Zink renderer stop working or crash. Are you sure you want to enable it?

column1: Batasi heap, atur GC, kunci layar 60 Hz. Matikan untuk membandingkan FPS.
column2: Limits the heap, tunes GC, and locks the screen to 60 Hz. Turn off to compare FPS.

column1: Serial: paling ringan untuk prosesor, jeda GC sedikit lebih panjang.
column2: Serial: lightest on the processor, slightly longer GC pauses.

column1: Bawaan: tanpa flag GC tambahan dari profil (hanya batas heap dan layar).
column2: Default: no extra GC flags from the profile (heap limit and screen only).

column1: Seimbang: G1 dengan jeda pendek dan memori terbatas. Coba ini dulu.
column2: Balanced: G1 with short pauses and limited memory. Try this first.

column1: Layar 90 Hz dikunci 60 Hz saat main supaya gerak lebih rata. HUD FPS menampilkan Hz yang aktif.
column2: A 90 Hz screen is locked to 60 Hz while playing for smoother motion. The FPS HUD shows the active Hz.

column1: Heap game: pilihanmu {0} MB, dipakai {1} MB. RAM HP ini {2} MB; heap lebih besar membuat HP menukar memori dan FPS turun.
column2: Game heap: you chose {0} MB, using {1} MB. This phone has {2} MB of RAM; a larger heap makes the phone swap memory and lowers FPS.

column1: Berlaku saat game dijalankan berikutnya. Dampaknya terlihat di HUD FPS (sisa RAM \u00b7 PANAS \u00b7 Hz).
column2: Applies the next time the game starts. The effect shows in the FPS HUD (RAM left \u00b7 HOT \u00b7 Hz).

column1: Makin kecil makin ringan untuk HP. Hemat 540p, Ringan 720p, Tajam 1080p.
column2: Smaller is lighter on the phone. Eco 540p, Light 720p, Sharp 1080p.

column1: 30 fps jauh lebih ringan. 60 fps hanya untuk HP yang kuat.
column2: 30 fps is much lighter. 60 fps only for powerful phones.

column1: Menambahkan suara dari mikrofon ke rekaman. Suara game belum ikut terekam.
column2: Adds microphone audio to the recording. Game sound is not recorded yet.

column1: Hentikan rekaman saat HP terlalu panas
column2: Stop recording when the phone overheats

column1: Menyimpan rekaman dan berhenti otomatis supaya game tidak ikut melambat karena panas.
column2: Saves the recording and stops automatically so the game does not slow down from heat.

column1: Game saja: tombol layar disembunyikan dari video (tetap bisa disentuh). Dengan tombol: tombol layar ikut terekam. Bisa diganti juga dari menu dalam game.
column2: Game only: on-screen buttons are hidden from the video (they still work). With buttons: on-screen buttons are recorded too. You can also change this from the in-game menu.

column1: Ketuk hotbar di bagian bawah layar untuk memilih slot, seperti di Minecraft Bedrock. Posisi slot mengikuti GUI scale game.
column2: Tap the hotbar at the bottom of the screen to select a slot, like in Minecraft Bedrock. Slot positions follow the game's GUI scale.

column1: Eksperimental. Nyalakan hanya bila memakai mod TouchController: tombol bawaan disembunyikan (hanya gerigi menu yang tersisa) dan semua sentuhan layar diteruskan ke mod. Bila layar tidak merespons, matikan.
column2: Experimental. Turn on only if you use the TouchController mod: the built-in controls are hidden (only the menu gear stays) and all screen touches are passed to the mod. If the screen stops responding, turn it off.

column1: # Mode Hemat, kunci layar 60 Hz umum, dan GC untuk HP RAM kecil
RAM HP ini {0} MB, jadi cara kerja pembersih memori Java bisa disetel.
column2: This phone has {0} MB of RAM, so how Java's memory cleaner works can be tuned.

column1: Serial: paling ringan untuk prosesor, jeda GC sedikit lebih panjang. Coba bila game sering tersendat.
column2: Serial: lightest on the processor, with slightly longer GC pauses. Try it if the game often stutters.

column1: Bawaan: tanpa flag GC tambahan dari launcher.
column2: Default: no extra GC flags from the launcher.

column1: Otomatis: G1 dengan memori terbatas, cocok untuk kebanyakan HP. Coba ini dulu.
column2: Auto: G1 with limited memory, good for most phones. Try this first.

column1: Berlaku saat game dijalankan berikutnya. Untuk membandingkan, lihat baris [Kinerja] di log game.
column2: Applies the next time the game starts. To compare, look at the [Kinerja] lines in the game log.

column1: Untuk HP yang cepat panas atau baterainya cepat habis.
column2: For phones that get hot quickly or drain the battery fast.

column1: Menyalakan mode performa stabil sistem dan V-Sync Zink, serta membatasi skala resolusi maksimal 80%.
column2: Turns on the system's sustained performance mode and Zink V-Sync, and caps the resolution scale at 80%.

column1: Berlaku saat game dijalankan berikutnya. Dimatikan kembali, setelan sebelumnya dipulihkan.
column2: Applies the next time the game starts. Turning it off restores your previous settings.

column1: Layar 90/120 Hz dikunci 60 Hz saat main supaya gerak lebih rata dan sedikit lebih hemat panas. Cocok bila game jarang mencapai 90 FPS. HUD FPS menampilkan Hz yang aktif.
column2: A 90/120 Hz screen is locked to 60 Hz while playing for smoother motion and slightly less heat. Good if the game rarely reaches 90 FPS. The FPS HUD shows the active Hz.
